digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and author-facing guides
propositions: Documentation guide `writing-a-passing-plan.md` must explain that when correctness resolves only after a slow codified delivery loop (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning), the plan must name risky mechanisms and commit to concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codifying.
The fast proof must be either a local run or a manual probe against the real target, and throwaway experiments must clean up teardown scoped only to resources they created.
The packaged guide must identify the new guidance as criterion T15, regenerate `criterion-pins.json` via the criterion parity tool, and remain stack-agnostic with no product-specific instructions.
Hand-authored overlay enumeration in `plan-review-gate.md` must update from stale T1–T12 range to T1–T15 and align stated criterion count with validated registry.
Registry module docstring in `registry.py` must state validated 44 criteria / T1–T15 vocabulary to keep implementation authority aligned with author-facing docs.
CLI `rebar explain plan` must render the new T15 guidance covering risky-mechanism naming, fast proof forms, and scoped-cleanup boundaries without breaking existing guidance rendering.
